name: godot-coda-engine
description: CODA: a language for clear Godot gameplay flows that generates inspectable GDScript.

scripts.test:godot: npm run gseos -- generate gseos/events/ui.reward.apply.gse.json >/dev/null && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/headless_runtime.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/reward_chain.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/generated_runner.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/competition.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/editor_transactions.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/event_dock_smoke.gd
scripts.validate:generated: npm run gseos -- generate gseos/events/ui.reward.apply.gse.json >/dev/null && godot --headless --path . --check-only --script res://.gseos/generated/ui_reward_apply.gd
scripts.export:pack: npm run gseos -- generate gseos/events/ui.reward.apply.gse.json >/dev/null && godot --headless --path . --export-pack "GSEOS Runtime Pack" /tmp/gseos-runtime.zip && npm run audit:pack
scripts.export:native:macos: npm run gseos -- generate gseos/events/ui.reward.apply.gse.json >/dev/null && godot --headless --path . --export-debug "GSEOS Runtime macOS" /tmp/GSEOSRuntime.app && "/tmp/GSEOSRuntime.app/Contents/MacOS/CODA Runtime" --headless --quit
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run check && npm run test:godot && npm run export:pack
